name: cucumber-botanical.png
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent botanical margin illustration for a Vegan Valley juice website, intended behind a 3D green juice bottle.
Primary request: An elegant botanical field-notebook illustration, finely shaded coloured-pencil in forest green #2f5a2c only. A loose airy study of a cucumber vine with two cucumbers, curling tendrils and veined leaves, one small lemon half at the base.
Composition/framing: Portrait-ish composition with lots of transparent gaps and fine graphite texture; naturally irregular handwork, sophisticated botanical drawing.
Scene/backdrop: Genuinely transparent background with actual alpha channel, not a simulated checkerboard.
Constraints: No text, no paper background, no drop shadow, no border, no logo. Produce exactly one image.

name: torn-paper-mask.png
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: isolated photographic white fibrous torn-paper alpha mask asset for colouring website section edges in CSS.
Primary request: Wide horizontal ratio about 3:1. A single sheet of unprinted white cotton paper occupies the lower 60 percent and reaches the LEFT, RIGHT and BOTTOM canvas edges. Its TOP edge is naturally hand-torn, slightly undulating, with small irregular fibre detail; irregularities restrained rather than zigzagged. The upper 40 percent is transparent background.
Composition/framing: Perfectly overhead flat view. White opaque paper body, actual transparent alpha above torn edge, not a simulated checkerboard.
Constraints: No text, no drawings, no other objects, no cast shadow. Produce exactly one image.
